ValidationRule.description: In Discussion needs a follow-up date and time, except for channel partners on the Partner Portal (partner users), for whom it is optional.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Call_Disposition__c, "In Discussion") ), ISBLANK(Follow_Up_DateTime__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL($Profile.UserType, "PowerPartner")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Follow-up Date Time is required when Call Disposition is In Discussion.
